title: Poplet - A Fidget Popper RPG-ish
author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
selftext:
Game Title: Poplet!

Playable Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.poplet.mobile

Platform: Android 

Description: Set out to make a simple bubble popping game and ended up making a casual fidget RPG. 

Weekly item hunts. Weekly mini games. Weekly community raid bosses.

Very happy how the game is growing and coming along.

Its very much free to play, and dont even need to dive into the rpg elements to enjoy it if fidget bubbles are your thing lol.

Latest Updates: Added Halloween themes and new ways for new players to get a head start!

New and improved daily login streak rewards!

First 5 days bonus rewards for new players!

Gem rewards for adding friends and their progression!

Try it out today!?
